ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(License_Expiry__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Hire_Date__c)), License_Expiry__c <= Hire_Date__c ), AND( ISNEW(), NOT(ISBLANK(License_Expiry__c)), License_Expiry__c < TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: License Expiry must be after Hire Date, and cannot be in the past when creating the driver.
